newsitem.title: USA: PHOENIX INSURANCE, CHARTER HOLDING CORP IN TIE-UP.
newsitem.headline: PHOENIX INSURANCE, CHARTER HOLDING CORP IN TIE-UP.

text.p: Phoenix Home Life Mutual Insurance Co said Wednesday it will form a strategic partnership with Charter Holding Corp. of Concord, N.H., to expand their trust services and distribute insurance and securities products to bank customers.
Phoenix said it intended to buy a majority interest in Charter Holding Corp., the parent holding company of Charter Trust Co., New Hampshire's biggest independent trust company.

Phoenix said the arrangement will expand trust operations in key Northeast target markets for its subsidiary, Phoenix Charter Oak Trust Co. It also fits in with the company's strategy to distribute life insurance products and services through banks.
The current owners of Charter Holding Corp., six New Hampshire community banks, will continue to be stockholders of the corporation.

The banks include Federal Savings Bank, Dover; Lake Sunapee Bank, Newport; Mascoma Savings Bank, Lebanon; Meredith Village Savings Bank, Meredith; Merrimack County Savings Bank, Concord; and Savings Bank of Walpole, Walpole, N.H.
